assertion_refresh_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T_WC_T2S_SERIE.ID_SERIE FROM T_WC_T2S_SERIE WHERE T_WC_T2S_SERIE.NUMBER_OF_SEASONS = 1 AND T_WC_T2S_SERIE.DAT_LAST_AIR IS NOT NULL AND T_WC_T2S_SERIE.STATUS NOT IN ('In Production', 'Planned', 'Post Production') ORDER BY T_WC_T2S_SERIE.IMDB_RATING_WEIGHTED DESC LIMIT 15
